author: National Geographic
description:
In this full episode of Pirates: Behind the Legends from National Geographic, dive into the rise and fall of Edward Teach, aka the infamous Blackbeard. 

Learn how Blackbeard transformed into history’s most feared high-seas outlaw aboard his stolen flagship, Queen Anne’s Revenge. Uncover the surprising truth behind Blackbeard’s legendary reign of terror, from his theatrical self-promotion to the remarkably democratic crew of outcasts and treasure-seekers who sailed under his command. Through his self-promotion and intimidation, he became one of the most well-known pirates of all time. 

Pirates: Behind the Legends | S1 E6
